---
title: "GB7CAM Network Graph (Operator View)"
format:
  html:
    theme: flatly
    page-layout: full
    self-contained: true
execute: 
  echo: false
---

<style>
body {
  background: #ffffff;
}

#controls {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 10px;
  align-items: center;
  font-family: sans-serif;
}

#cy {
  width: 100%;
  height: 85vh;
  border: 1px solid #e5e5e5;
  border-radius: 6px;
}

/* operator mode styling */
.operator {
  background: #f7f9fc;
  border: 1px solid #d0d7de;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  border-radius: 6px;
}

.label {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #444;
}
</style>

<div id="controls">

  <div class="operator">
    <label>
      <input type="checkbox" id="opMode">
      Operator Mode
    </label>
  </div>

  <div>
    <span class="label">Filter node:</span>
    <input type="text" id="filter" placeholder="e.g. GB7FCI" />
  </div>

</div>

<div id="cy"></div>

<script src="https://unpkg.com/cytoscape@3.26.0/dist/cytoscape.min.js"></script>

<script>
const API = "https://api.gb7cam.org.uk/graph";

let cy;
let fullData = null;

/* Port mapping (your real system) */
function portColor(port) {
  switch(String(port)) {
    case "3": return "#1f77b4"; // AXIP (blue)
    case "1": return "#2ca02c"; // RF (green)
    case "2": return "#ffbf00"; // telnet/internal (amber)
    default:  return "#999999";
  }
}

/* Node type detection (ONLY derived from alias, not guesswork) */
function nodeStyle(node) {
  const alias = (node.alias || "").toUpperCase();

  let color = "#6c757d";

  if (alias.includes("BBS")) color = "#d62728";   // red = BBS
  if (alias.includes("CHAT")) color = "#9467bd";  // purple = chat
  if (alias.includes("NODE")) color = "#17a2b8";  // cyan = node

  return color;
}

/* Ensure GB7CAM is always present */
function normaliseNodes(nodes) {
  const hasCam = nodes.some(n => n.id === "GB7CAM");

  if (!hasCam) {
    nodes.push({
      id: "GB7CAM",
      alias: "LOCAL",
    });
  }

  return nodes;
}

function buildElements(data) {
  const nodes = normaliseNodes(data.nodes);

  const elements = [];

  for (const n of nodes) {
    elements.push({
      data: {
        id: n.id,
        label: n.id + (n.alias ? `\n${n.alias}` : "")
      }
    });
  }

  for (const e of data.edges) {

    const width = Math.max(1, (e.quality || 0) / 80);

    elements.push({
      data: {
        source: e.source,
        target: e.target,
        quality: e.quality,
        port: e.port || e.type || "3"
      }
    });
  }

  return elements;
}

function render(data) {

  const elements = buildElements(data);

  cy = cytoscape({
    container: document.getElementById('cy'),

    elements,

    layout: {
      name: 'cose',
      animate: true,
      fit: true,
      padding: 40
    },

    style: [

      /* nodes */
      {
        selector: 'node',
        style: {
          'label': 'data(label)',
          'text-wrap': 'wrap',
          'font-size': 10,
          'background-color': ele => nodeStyle(ele.data()),
          'color': '#222',
          'text-valign': 'center',
          'text-halign': 'center',
          'width': 28,
          'height': 28,
          'border-width': 1,
          'border-color': '#ccc'
        }
      },

      /* edges */
      {
        selector: 'edge',
        style: {
          'curve-style': 'bezier',
          'line-color': ele => portColor(ele.data('port')),
          'width': ele => Math.max(1, (ele.data('quality') || 0) / 60),
          'opacity': 0.75,
          'target-arrow-shape': 'triangle',
          'target-arrow-color': ele => portColor(ele.data('port'))
        }
      }
    ]
  });

  setupUI();
}

function setupUI() {

  const filterBox = document.getElementById("filter");
  const opMode = document.getElementById("opMode");

  filterBox.addEventListener("input", () => applyFilter());
  opMode.addEventListener("change", () => applyFilter());

}

function applyFilter() {

  const filter = document.getElementById("filter").value.toUpperCase();
  const opMode = document.getElementById("opMode").checked;

  cy.nodes().forEach(n => {

    const id = n.id();
    const label = (n.data('label') || "").toUpperCase();

    let visible = true;

    if (filter && !(id.includes(filter) || label.includes(filter))) {
      visible = false;
    }

    /* operator mode hides low-activity fluff nodes */
    if (opMode) {
      const degree = n.degree();
      if (degree === 0) visible = false;
    }

    n.style("display", visible ? "element" : "none");
  });

  cy.edges().forEach(e => {
    const src = e.source().style("display");
    const tgt = e.target().style("display");
    e.style("display", (src === "element" && tgt === "element") ? "element" : "none");
  });

}

fetch(API)
  .then(r => r.json())
  .then(data => {
    fullData = data;
    render(data);
  })
  .catch(err => {
    console.error("Graph load failed", err);
    document.getElementById("cy").innerHTML =
      "<p style='color:red'>Graph load failed</p>";
  });

</script>
